NEW EVENTS — ARMOR, WEAPONS AND HEIRLOOMS, ARM-46 to ARM-95 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

collection.description: The keeper of the storehouse sings a long song naming every implement instead of keeping a written list.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (Name1), the keeper of the storehouse, does not keep a written list of the implements; they sing a long song naming every one. An apprentice starts learning the song and finds three verses for objects that are no longer there.
